datasheet.title: LM2598 SIMPLE SWITCHER® Power Converter 150-kHz 1-A Step-Down Voltage Regulator, With Features

notes: The canonical schematic value LM2598_ADJ selects the adjustable-output characteristics, not a fixed 3.3 V, 5 V or 12 V device.
The recommended operating temperature starts at -25 degC in this datasheet; it must not be generalized to -40 degC.
Output range and current are IC capabilities, not measured values for this example.

input_voltage.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

output_voltage.conditions: Application capability stated in the datasheet; external components, input voltage and temperature constrain usable operation.

output_current.conditions: Application capability stated in the datasheet; external components, input voltage and temperature constrain usable operation.

operating_junction_temperature.conditions: Operating temperature; interpreted as junction temperature consistently with the electrical-characteristic limits.

input_voltage_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

junction_temperature_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

storage_temperature.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

feedback_reference_voltage.conditions: Adjustable version, TJ = 25 degC; VIN = 4.5 to 40 V, ILOAD = 0.1 to 1 A, VOUT programmed for 3 V; Figures 42 and 45.

switching_frequency.conditions: Adjustable version, VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row states otherwise. Frequency reduces under second-stage current limit.

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

switch_current_limit.conditions: Adjustable version, VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row states otherwise. No diode, inductor or capacitor on output pin; feedback forced to 0 V (footnotes 4 and 5).

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

quiescent_current.conditions: Adjustable version, VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row states otherwise. SD/SS open, feedback disconnected from output and tied to 12 V to force switch off (footnote 6).

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

shutdown_current.conditions: TJ = 25 degC, VIN = 40 V, SD/SS = 0 V (footnote 7).

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

maximum_duty_cycle.conditions: Adjustable version, VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row states otherwise. Feedback forced to 0 V (footnote 5).
